evidence.algorithm_cause: generate_candidate_pairs.py accepts a positive proposal only when neither endpoint is in the global matched set; equivalence components may legitimately have more than two members

findings.retest: Remove the one-to-one positive matching restriction; build graph components from every source-confirmed positive edge, explicitly resolve contradictory proposals, regenerate the full universe/relation/group artifact as a new version, and repeat full independent A9 review.
findings.title: One-to-one positive matching suppresses source-confirmed equivalent edges and fragments groups
